summary.name: Bargo (SwiftAlerts)
summary.one_liner: Bargo, reached through swiftalerts.trade, is an AI market-research service that delivers source-backed, verified financial data (earnings, filings, calls, insider and market data) to AI assistants.
use_cases: checking company guidance against analyst consensus
monitoring GPU rental prices and AI capacity
verifying numbers quoted by AI assistants about public companies
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Bargo as AI infrastructure for public-market research, covering earnings, podcasts, jobs, AI economics, news, ownership and market data. It says it connects AI assistants such as Claude, Codex and Cursor to this structured data. Its stated focus is verification: figures are matched digit-for-digit against source filings, calculated numbers come from a calculator rather than the model, and quotes link to the company's recording at the exact second. The page also shows indexes including a Compute Tightness Index for GPU rental pricing and a Token Demand Index for AI inference demand, plus signals such as 13F holdings, insider activity, options flow and Korea exports.
notable: Verification layer that checks every number against the source filing and separates quoted, calculated and recalled figures
Quotes linked to the company's own earnings call recording at the exact second
Compute Tightness Index: daily 0-100 gauge of H100, H200 and B200 GPU rental tightness
Token Demand Index tracking AI inference token volume and price per token by provider group
caveats: Listed in the collective-ai-tools directory with a #paid tag, suggesting a paid offering
Page text is mostly marketing; the sample answer is labeled illustrative and no pricing or plan details are shown
